survey: An inflatable beach ball sits on sand, tilted so that one pole faces up and toward the camera. Six gore panels run from that pole: red, white, blue, white, green and white. Each one narrows to a point under a round purple valve cap at the pole, which sits flush where the panels meet. The ball is evenly round and slightly bedded into the sand, with a contact shadow under it, so it rests on the ground and does not float. The panel seams curve the way meridians would on a sphere.
